conviction_note: The print turns on whether the FY26 $650-700m revenue / $180-220m adj. EBITDA guide survives with H1 at only $211.9m. That needs H2 of $438-488m, and the low end already excludes US launches. Counterparty and capacity evidence (Teva naming SIMLANDI a top US product in Q3; two FDA capacity approvals in October) leans toward a hold. The arithmetic and the Nov-2025 precedent (guide cut, -10.5% after hours) lean the other way. The Q3 bar is disputed ($118m / $137m / $163m), so the Q3-line findings are capped small. Net: findings sum +0.2, p_up 52 on an 8% abs move. The two measurements agree that there is no strong edge.
bar: DISPUTED. Q3 2026 revenue consensus is $137.1m with EPS about -$0.01 per Earnings Whispers (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/ALVO/22821, 2026-11-03). Chartmill shows $118.4m with EPS -$0.05 and says the next-quarter estimate was revised down 27.8% over 3 months (snippet only; the page returned 403). Benzinga KR and TheRightTrader show about $163m (snippets only). FY26 consensus is $663.8m (Earnings Whispers), in the lower half of the company guide of $650-700m revenue and $180-220m adj. EBITDA (H1 release, https://finviz.com/news/383886/alvotech-announces-financial-results-for-the-first-half-of-2026-and-provides-a-business-update, 2026-08-19). The guide is the only well-sourced bar. The guide's low end excludes US revenues from AVT03, AVT05 and AVT06 approvals and launches (Q1 call, https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/05/08/alvotech-alvo-q1-2026-earnings-transcript/). Findings on the Q3 line are capped small because the bar cannot be sourced to two agreeing estimates.
positioning_check: No listed options (baseline: no_options_market), so there is no skew and no implied move. Short interest about 6.4M shares at the 2026-09-30 settlement with about 4.0 days to cover; about 5.8M and 8.8 days at 2026-09-15 (FINRA via CurvedTrading search snippet; page 403). Equibles (snippet) gives about 1.57% of float on 2026-09-11. Not a crowded short. No October settlement found. Tape: spot 4.955, run_up_5d +6.1%, run_up_20d -4.2%, 19% off the 52-week high. The stock was about $5.42 on 2026-09-16 after a Barclays double upgrade from UW to OW with an $8 target. Earnings Whispers bearish sentiment is 42.4%.

findings.finding: Teva, Alvotech's US commercial partner, reported Q3 2026 on 2026-11-03 (after Alvotech last spoke on 2026-08-19). It named SIMLANDI (Alvotech's Humira biosimilar) among its most significant US generic products in the quarter, credited higher biosimilar revenues, and said its biosimilars business will exceed $0.8bn of 2026 revenue, 'achieving our original 2027 revenue objective one year ahead of plan'. This points to Q3 sell-through and partner orders recovering after Alvotech's H1 product revenue fell 48% to $105.9m. Teva does not break out biosimilar dollars.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Product revenue on confirmed releases: Q1 2026 product $51m, revenue miss, shares about -7.3% premarket (2026-05-07). H1 2026 revenue -31% but guide held, +7.0% the next session (2026-08-20). Q3 2025 revenue miss plus guide cut, -10.5% after hours (2025-11-12).
findings.why_not_priced: Biosimilars are buried inside Teva's generics line (US generics including biosimilars $718m, -39%), and Teva's headline was its innovative brands. The ALVO preview (Earnings Whispers 2026-11-03) does not mention Teva's commentary. Had the market priced it, Q3 estimates would sit near the top of the dispersed range ($163m) and not at $118-137m, with the Chartmill next-quarter estimate down 27.8%.
findings.independence: Separate source: Alvotech's own H1 release says manufacturing 'returned to planned operating levels at the end of the second quarter', with supply being built for confirmed demand (https://finviz.com/news/383886/alvotech-announces-financial-results-for-the-first-half-of-2026-and-provides-a-business-update). Teva's document is a counterparty disclosure, qualitative on SIMLANDI.

findings.finding: The FDA approved two supply changes in October. On 2026-10-05 it approved the DSM2 suite for US SIMLANDI drug substance, which 'effectively doubles the drug substance manufacturing capacity available to support U.S. supply'. On 2026-10-20 it approved a new SIMLANDI process that more than doubles output per batch. Both lift Q4 supply capacity, and the guide relies on a strong Q4 ('Q4 2026 to be the strongest quarter of the year').
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose +12.1% on 2026-10-05 (DSM2) and +1.8% on 2026-10-20 (process approval), so the market has already paid once for this line.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the +12% day is in the tape. What is not yet visible is whether management turns the extra capacity into a reaffirmed or firmer Q4 number on the call. A hold would look like FY consensus moving from $663.8m toward the guide midpoint.
findings.independence: Second document: the 2026-10-20 release, 'Alvotech receives FDA approval for new SIMLANDI manufacturing process that more than doubles output per batch' (https://www.placera.se/telegram/avanza/10_88fc24c1-5c76-48a7-b3de-d3f825972093.html). Both are company releases on the same facility.

findings.finding: The guide-credibility risk. FY26 revenue of $650-700m is held for three updates, with H1 at $211.9m, so H2 must be $438-488m. Consensus implies Q4 above $310m against Q2 at about $106m, and the low end excludes US launches of AVT03, AVT05 and AVT06. The FDA goal date for those is 2026-12-04, after this print. So at this print management must either hold a target that rests on Q4 milestone and licence timing it calls 'inherently lumpy', or cut. The company cut its FY guide at the Q3 2025 print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (Nov 2025): revenue $113.7m missed $117.2m and FY25 guide was cut to $570-600m; shares -10.5% after hours (https://www.itiger.com/news/1111649061, 2025-11-13). H1 2026: guide held on a weak half, +7.0% next session.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: FY consensus of $663.8m already sits in the lower half, and Chartmill notes a 27.8% cut to the next-quarter estimate. Fully priced would mean consensus below $650m, i.e. the street pricing a cut. It does not. A cut to below $650m is therefore not in the bar.
findings.independence: The Motley Fool report (undated, post-H1) says the company 'must deliver a staggering performance in the final three months' and that a single partner's delayed order can 'wreck a quarter' (https://www.fool.com/report/nasdaq-alvo/?partner=yahoo). The arithmetic is from the company's own H1 release.

findings.finding: New licence deals support H2 licence and milestone revenue, which was $105.7m in H1 (+4.4% y/y) and about half of revenue. On 2026-08-21 Alvotech signed with Lotus Pharmaceutical for durvalumab and emicizumab biosimilars (US and Asia), up to about $150m in upfront and milestone payments; the split is not disclosed. On 2026-10-14 it announced with Advanz Pharma the first known regulatory submission for an Eylea 8 mg biosimilar, a submission-type milestone trigger. The Q1 call named submissions as H2 milestone triggers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Licence revenue was $55m in Q1 2026 and about $51m in Q2 2026. No separate reaction to the licence line can be isolated. The stock moved +3.75% on 2026-08-21 (Lotus) and -3.9% on 2026-10-14 (Advanz).
findings.why_not_priced: The upfront is undisclosed, so no estimate can carry a sourced amount. If priced, Q3 estimates would cluster rather than spread from $118m to $163m.
findings.independence: Separate document: the Advanz Eylea 8 mg submission release (https://www.placera.se/telegram/avanza/10_7eb1062b-6e30-4982-97f6-02c066c37c88.html, 2026-10-14). The Q1 transcript names submissions as milestone triggers.

findings.finding: Alvotech booked a $20.2m H1 2026 provision for 'commercial and contractual matters' and kept the details confidential. Earnings Whispers lists 'the undisclosed commercial provision booked last quarter' as a watch item. A further charge or an adverse disclosure in Q3 is a below-the-line risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This provision has not been isolated before. H1 (when it was booked) traded +7%, so the market looked through it once.
findings.why_not_priced: The nature of the provision is undisclosed, so nobody can price a follow-on. If a repeat were expected, EBITDA consensus would sit below the $180m guide low end, and no source shows that.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers preview names the same provision (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/ALVO/22821). Shares the H1 release as root.

findings.finding: The Q3 revenue bar has been cut and is dispersed. Chartmill shows a Q3 revenue estimate of $118.4m, revised down 27.8% over three months, against $137.1m at Earnings Whispers and about $163m elsewhere. Q3 2025 was $113.7m. With production back at plan from end-Q2 and Teva reporting biosimilar strength, a Q3 above $130m clears most of the bars. This is capped small because the bar is unsourced.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 missed by about 3% (with a guide cut): -10.5%. Q1 2026 missed by about 6%: about -7% premarket. Headline misses have been sold.
findings.why_not_priced: The lowered estimate is itself the market's expectation. The point is only that the low end of the dispersion is beatable. If priced uniformly, all aggregators would show one number.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers $137.1m (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/ALVO/22821) disagrees with this estimate. The two sources conflict, hence the cap.

outside_window.finding: FDA decision deadline of 2026-12-04 for the resubmitted AVT05 (Simponi), AVT06 (Eylea) and AVT03 (Prolia/Xgeva) BLAs. These are upside to the guide's low end, and approval milestones and launches decide the Q4 number.

Janssen BPCIA suit (E.D. Va., filed 2026-06-19, 14 patents, injunction sought) against AVT05 golimumab. A ruling could block the US launch even after FDA approval. The ruling is expected around year end.
AVT16 (Entyvio biosimilar) BLA accepted by the FDA; decision expected early 2027.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree with. The 5-day run-up of +6.1% after a -4.2% 20-day leaves the stock below its September post-upgrade level ($5.42), so the tape is not pricing a strong hold. The balanced findings fit that.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar disputed: $118m/$137m/$163m): lowered-bar finding capped from +0.5 to +0.3, and the Teva Q3-line finding cut from +1.0 to +0.8.
Rule 6 (window): the Janssen golimumab litigation finding (-0.3) moved to outside_window, because the ruling is expected around year end and the FDA goal date is 2026-12-04.
Rule 2 (one-offs): provision finding trimmed from -0.5 to -0.4 as a below-the-line item with no stated path to the guide.
Rebuild base rate from confirmed releases: Q3'25 -10.5% after hours, Q1'26 about -7% premarket, H1'26 +7.0%. The baseline's 7-day 'cadence' history was ignored. abs_move 8 left standing.
Rule 7: short interest checked, about 1.6% of float and 4 days to cover, not crowded; the negative guidance finding was left at -1.5.
The draft sum (+0.2) equals the final sum (+0.2) by coincidence: the cuts to positive findings offset the negative finding moved out of the window.
